full_text:
3 months ago, my executive content sounded like generic AI slop.

Off-the-shelf prompts generated robotic posts that lost 70% of organic reader engagement.

We built a vector style cloner using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and Qdrant. Now posts match my exact cadence and vocabulary.

Result: Virality scores jumped from 62 to 89, saving 2 hours every day.

How are you preserving authentic executive voice when using LLMs for branding?
